lines.name: Liquid Demi
lines.developer: Pulp Riot Liquid Demi Developer (proprietary, no standard vol number listed)
lines.processingTime: 20 minutes standard (no heat); 40 minutes for grey blending (20 min no heat + 20 min under dryer); less than 20 minutes for softer deposit
lines.notes: Seamless color blending. Numbering system matches Faction8 Permanent Color Line.

numberingSystem.description: Level before separator = depth. Numbers after separator = tone(s). Single tone = 100% that tone. Two different tones = primary + secondary. Two identical = Intense. /prefix = Booster.
